scripted-mismatch.title: One value asked for, five returned
scripted-mismatch.question: What is the average grade in Databases in Fall 2025?
scripted-mismatch.answer: The question asks for a single value, but the query returned 5 rows.
scripted-mismatch.sql:
SELECT e.grade AS grade FROM enrollments e JOIN offerings o ON o.id = e.offering_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = o.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Databases' AND o.semester = '2025-Fall'
